summary: OpenAI launched ChatGPT for Teens, an age-gated ChatGPT experience with built-in safety protections, parental controls, and learning-focused features like Study Mode and Study Hours.

practices.reason: OpenAI describes new under-18 evaluations added to system cards for teen-specific sensitive-content cases, but this is an internal lab process rather than a transferable benchmark.
practices.quote: starting with new under 18 evaluations we’ve added to our system cards that show how our models perform against teen-specific standards in challenging sensitive-content cases
